cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A uses its former pupil learned question-asking and concise-message habits to enlist limited secret custody while avoiding full disclosure.
confusable: Not just refusing information: A grades B caution and corrects its desired level of detail, then teaches a safer brief signal.
comparison: Moving an envelope versus a temporary key bargain with a deadline.
seedUse: D121 cupboard key/flatmate/nothing alive/work signal; S05 pupil questions and short requests.
